correctness.rationale: Explicit gradient values at every F_q-point on Z=1 and at infinity give the exact t-parameterization and exclude hidden rational singularities. The local quadratic and cubic jets are calculated in all odd characteristics, including cancellation of q=3 Frobenius cubic terms. Discriminant 4t(t^7-4) proves the node criterion; the nonzero cubic term (1/2)t^-4 along the double tangent yields a delta-one ordinary cusp. Each t selects one k, and the cusp elimination, quadratic character identity, and smooth genus-three curve point count give the full census for all odd prime powers. verify.py independently tests 14 prime fields, exhaustively checking projective singular supports for the 5 smallest. No extrapolation from finite tests is used for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The originating source asks about smoothness of a canonical degree-q+3 plane-filling pencil but only tests existence of rational singularities. Local singular type and Frobenius branch splitting control normalization and arithmetic behavior of bad members, so the new exact parameter-wide classification addresses a motivated gap. The distinct characteristic-three concentration, cusp parameter boundary and genus-three discriminant cover provide a natural structural explanation of split-versus-nonsplit variation across all finite fields, rather than an arbitrary single-field count. It does not claim to settle the global smoothness conjecture.
